title: Cairo by Train 🚆 Golden Sunset on the Nile Lofi Window Ride | 5-Minute Chillhop Journey
description:
Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride along the Nile through an illustrated Cairo at a warm golden sunset: the Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx glowing beyond palm groves, white-sailed feluccas on the river, the Cairo Tower and domed mosques with slender minarets, with mellow chillhop the whole way.

Lofi Train POV: cozy illustrated train-window journeys through the world's cities, set to relaxing chillhop. A new city every day. Sit back, look out the window, and stay as long as you like.

Stylised illustrated artwork; not real footage.
Music: "Golden Hour" and "Desert Rain" by Purrple Cat (purrplecat.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Tracks were trimmed and cross-faded.
